name: Threads of You: Beyond the Bay
source:
You're on a much needed road trip to visit back home after being away for college when your car suddenly breaks down in the middle of nowhere. Luckily, a sheriff drives past and takes you to the humble town of Brine Bay until your car gets fixed.

As you settle in, you'll have the chance to get to know seven interesting men: Caring yet stern Jean; high-maintenance and pompous Wyatt; determined and talented Kevin; masterfully flirtatious Kai; loyal and gentle Chris; nonchalant and brooding Vince and supportive and friendly, Andrew.

Get to know them over the course of two weeks and learn all about them. Will you pursue a relationship or choose to make lifelong friends instead? Maybe you want more than one partner or want to see them with each other? Either way, it was clear you were meant to be in their lives and them in yours.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750770/Threads_of_You_Beyond_the_Bay/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
上完大学后，你正在一次急需的公路旅行中回家，这时你的车突然在一个偏僻的地方抛锚了。幸运的是，一位警长开车经过并带你前往布赖恩湾（Brine Bay）这个简陋的小镇，直到你的车修好。

当你安顿下来后，你将有机会结识七个有趣的男人：关心但严厉的吉恩；难伺候、浮夸的怀亚特；意志坚定、才华横溢的凯文；熟练调情的凯；忠诚而温柔的克里斯；冷漠而沉思的文斯和支持而友善的安德鲁。

在两周的时间里了解他们并了解他们的一切。你会追求一段感情还是选择结交终生的朋友？也许你想要多个合作伙伴或希望看到他们在一起？不管怎样，很明显你应该出现在他们的生活中，他们也应该出现在你的生活中。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750770/Threads_of_You_Beyond_the_Bay/]Steam[/url]]
